capabilities: Stamp a configurable frontmatter property with the current date/time on note edits
Ignore modify events not caused by the user, such as sync, git pulls, and other plugins
Configure the property name and any moment.js date format with a live preview
Exclude folders from stamping and autofill exclusions from Templates and Templater
Skip Excalidraw drawings and apply a per-file cooldown between stamps
disambiguation: It does not insert timestamps into note text; it only writes a frontmatter property.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Edits made outside the editor (Properties sidebar, Bases tables) do not update the timestamp.
problem: Obsidian does not automatically record a last-modified timestamp in a note's properties, so tracking when a note was last changed requires manual work.

relations.evidence: reads the configuration of the core Templates plugin and the Templater community plugin
Files produced by the Excalidraw plugin are detected (by filename or excalidraw-plugin frontmatter key) and skipped automatically
Properties and Dataview read it as a date

summary: Timestamp plugin that writes the current date and time to a configurable frontmatter property each time a note is edited and saved.
